_meta.title: OpenClaw 派活失败路径实测样本(events_wait 通路)
_meta.collector: JSON-RPC over stdio -> `openclaw mcp serve`; events_poll baseline + events_wait loop, cursor advanced from event.cursor; bridge connected BEFORE dispatch in every case
_meta.note_events_raw: events_raw[].event 为 events_wait 返回的 structuredContent.event 原样对象,未裁剪
_meta.note_tasks_show: final_tasks_show 取自 `openclaw tasks show <K> --json` 的 stderr(见 preflight-live.md D-1)
_meta.sibling: 结论见 preflight-live.md 第 6 节
